evidence.title: Coolors - The super fast color palettes generator!

name: Coolors
summary: Color palette generator with millions of community schemes, image color picker, contrast checker and gradient tools.
description: Free browser app for creating color palettes: hit the spacebar for instant combinations or browse millions of community schemes by topic, style or color. Extra tools cover image color extraction, WCAG contrast checking, palette visualization on real designs, gradient making, color pickers, Tailwind color previews and AI color suggestions.
contains: 10M+ palettes to explore; spacebar generates new ones
tools: palette generator, image picker, contrast checker, palette visualizer, color picker, color bot
exports: URL, PDF, image, CSS, ASE, SVG, code, Tailwind, embed
free plan: palettes up to 5 colors, 10 saved palettes, 1 project, 1 collection
Pro plan adds AI palette generation, no ads, palettes up to 10 colors and 3,000 credits/mo
iOS app, Figma plugin, Chrome and Adobe extensions
palettes free for commercial and non-commercial use without attribution; resale or redistribution not allowed
used by 8+ million designers and creatives
